description:
Extensive development experience in WebDynpro Java, Visual Composer, Web Page Composer. 
 Development experience in CE 7.3 and above 
 Hands on end-to-end development experience with SAP Portal 7.3 
 At least 3 to 5 years of SAP CE Portal development experience including work on version 7.3. 
 At least 5 to 7 years of overall SAP Experience.  
 Familiar with EJB and Database concepts 
 Development experience in Portal KM, Security 
 Experience in developing Portal components and Portal Services. 
 Should have knowledge of SAP NetWeaver Stack, SSO, FPN  
 Development best practices and implementation methodologies 
 Effective communication skills  

 CE/Portal BPM and BRM development experience 
 Working knowledge with NWDI and CTS+ is required  
 Experience in integrating external Repositories in KM. 
 Strong knowledge of enterprise application design patterns, EJB, JPA, SOA concepts, NetWeaver Java 
 Familiar with SAP ABAP and SAP PI helpful 
 SAP Solution Manager / Service Desk  
 SAP Portal Certification 
 HTML/HTML5, JQuery, JSON, JavaScript, AJAX, SAPUI5 

 Duration: Full Time 
 
 
 Eligiblity: GC & US Citizens Only 
 
 Share the Profiles to mkonni(at)1stitsolutions.com  

 
 Contact: 703-349-1214 
 
 
 Keep the subject line with Job Title and Location
